useCases.title: Research the legal or regulatory landscape for a decision
useCases.message: Help me research the legal or regulatory landscape for a decision I am making. Ask me what the decision involves and which jurisdiction applies. Then find the key laws, recent rulings, and any official guidance, and give me a clear summary of what I need to be aware of.
